item.title: Structural Distortions and Ferroelectricity in Antiperovskite Oxides with Tetrel Elements
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 He Zhu, Turan Birol
arXiv:2602.06324v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Antiperovskites share the same structure as perovskites, but allow completely different chemistries and nominal charge states of anions to be stabilized. This gives rise to many interesting phenomena, including septet superconductivity and topological crystalline insulating phases in these systems. Despite this, the work on the crystal structural trends in these compounds is more limited compared to perovskites. In this study, we consider the family of antiperovskite oxides with tetrel elements (Si, Ge, Sn, Pb) and alkaline earth metals (Ca, Sr, Ba), and perform a detailed study of their crystal structures using first principles density functional theory. We show how tolerance factor arguments can be constructed to predict their structur…

item.title: 超导氢化镧中的四极相变
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abhishek Raghav (Institut de Minéralogie, de Physique des Matériaux et de Cosmochimie, Sorbonne Université, CNRS UMR 7590, Paris, France, Center for Emergent Matter Science, RIKEN, Wako, Japan), Kousuke Nakano (Center for Emergent Matter Science, RIKEN, Wako, Japan, Center for Basic Research on Materials, National Institute for Materials Science), Marco Cherubini (Institut de Minéralogie, de Physique des Matériaux et de Cosmochimie, Sorbonne Université, CNRS UMR 7590, Paris, France), Ryotaro Arita (Center for Emergent Matter Science, RIKEN, Wako, Japan, Department of Physics, The University of Tokyo, Japan), Michele Casula (Institut de Minéralogie, de Physique des Matériaux et de Cosmochimie, Sorbonne Université, CNRS UMR 7590, Paris, France)
该研究针对高压超导氢化镧 LaH₁₀ 的 Rbar3m 到 Fmbar3m 结构相变，利用团簇多极矩分析揭示其由氢子晶格中的四极 T₂g 序参量触发，并具有弱一阶性质。结合路径积分分子动力学和 MACE 神经网络势，作者发现序参量在相变处塌缩，并伴随光学 T₂g 声子的非连续软化。结果表明，低频四极畸变相关结构不稳定性可能是增强超氢化物超导性的关键因素。

item.title: 晶体磁体中载流子可调的 RKKY 磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xiang S. W. Huang, Bruno K. Saika, Satoshi Hamao, Yuki Majima, Yuki Settai, Hideki Matsuoka, Yuki M. Itahashi, Masato Sakano, Taro Nakajima, Shinichiro Seki, Yoshihiro Iwasa, Kyoko Ishizaka, Masaki Nakano
该研究利用薄膜方法在同一 NbSe₂ 晶体宿主中独立调控 RKKY 相互作用中的磁矩间距和费米波矢。作者通过分子束外延稳定不同 Cr 超结构，并通过生长后退火改变载流子密度而保持结构不变，从而实验上解耦载流子密度与磁矩几何。结果显示 Cr-NbSe₂ 是低载流子密度、载流子敏感的 RKKY 磁性体系，该 MBE 加退火策略可推广至插层过渡金属二硫属化物家族。

item.title: 有限温度下无序合金相稳定性与力学性质的机器学习方法
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rutchapon Hunkao, Urvesh Patil, Stefano Sanvito
该研究以 Ni-Pd 体系为原型，构建了基于密度泛函理论数据的高效 Jacobi-Legendre 机器学习势，用于预测无序合金在有限温度下的稳定性。作者通过三体项以内的团簇展开和直接积分可及微观态计算配分函数，确认 Ni 与 Pd 可形成 fcc 固溶体，并揭示其室温亚稳、约 600 K 后热力学稳定。该方法为无序合金及高熵合金等多组分体系提供了高通量研究流程。

item.title: 利用 SCAN 族机器学习势准确预测液态钠中的氧溶解焓
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该文发表于 Computational Materials Science，主题是利用 SCAN 族机器学习势预测液态钠中氧的溶解焓。输入信息仅提供了题名、期刊卷期和作者等元数据，未给出研究摘要，因此具体方法细节、数值结果和结论需查阅原文。根据题名可谨慎概括，该工作围绕液态钠体系中氧溶解热力学性质的计算材料建模展开。

item.title: 通过不确定性感知的多保真筛选加速发现极端功函数材料
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jun Meng, Ryan Jacobs, Rehan Kapadia, John Booske
本文将机器学习与多保真筛选相结合，构建了用于加速发现极低和极高功函数材料的数据驱动框架。作者在既有随机森林模型中加入不确定性校准和适用域评估，并结合通用机器学习原子间势模拟与针对性从头算，筛选了550万种化合物。工作识别出数百个极端低/高功函数表面，并揭示了与碱金属、碱土金属、镧系元素、类金属和磷相关的化学趋势。

item.title: 用于量子磁体中不确定性感知哈密顿量推断与实验设计的观测几何
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Roy Liu, Venugopal Ranganathan, David Dahlbom, Shizhou Xu, Tianyu Zhang, Yuan Ni, Daniel M. Pajerowski, Garrett Granroth, Thomas Strohmer, Matthew B. Stone, Andrew F. May, Mark D. Lumsden, Joshua J. Turner, Yongqiang Cheng, Zhantao Chen
该工作提出一种人工智能驱动框架，用于在量子磁体中进行具有不确定性感知的哈密顿量推断和自适应实验设计。框架结合哈密顿量条件神经替代模型、贝叶斯推断和观测几何，直接在物理参数空间中刻画实验数据对微观相互作用的约束。作者以 NiPS₃ 的粉末和单晶非弹性中子散射多模态测量为例，展示了可解释的哈密顿量推断、模态感知不确定性量化和实验设计能力。

item.description:

arXiv:2608.10059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding correlated quantum matter starts with an accurate model of the single-particle states that interact at low energies: their dispersion, band geometry, orbital content and charge density. In many cases, notably the topological bands of moire materials, it is not straightforward to find a real-space description with a few local orbitals that accomplishes this task. Here we provide a systematic way to identify the local degrees of freedom that best capture the band geometry and charge density of any chosen set of bands. We use the unit-cell one-particle reduced density matrix (UC-1pRDM), obtained by restricting the projector onto the target bands to a single unit cell. item.title: Chirality and quasi-long-range order in finite-flux Gutzwiller states for magnetized frustrated magnets
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wen O. Wang, Urban F. P. Seifert, Oleg A. Starykh, Leon Balents
arXiv:2601.14458v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study Gutzwiller-projected wavefunctions for triangular-lattice U(1) Dirac spin liquids in a Zeeman field, where we allow the U(1) gauge field to develop a gauge flux, resulting in (spin-split) spinon Landau levels. We find that at a given magnetization, the optimal candidate state has a finite flux chosen such that the spinon filling lies in a |C|=1 Landau-level gap: it gives the lowest variational energy and the smallest energy variance within our correlation-matrix reconstruction for local Heisenberg-type models. By symmetry, we argue that the finite gauge flux results in a non-zero (staggered) scalar spin chirality, as also numerically observed, and further find that the |C|=1 state exhibits dominant quasi-long-ranged 120ⁱ̧rc magn…

item.title: 耗散 Rydberg 晶格中 Landau-Zener 隧穿的动力学交叉
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Suvechha Indu, Raka Dasgupta
该研究考察具有时变失谐的 Rabi 耦合耗散 Rydberg 晶格中的激发动力学，并分别采用平均场 Lindblad 主方程和有效非厄米哈密顿量描述。结果显示，体系可在避免交叉附近出现子晶格布居不平衡消失、两子晶格 Landau-Zener 概率相同的区域；超过临界有效阻塞强度后，进入布居不平衡持续存在且概率具有子晶格依赖性的动力学交叉区域。Rydberg 相互作用在不同 Rabi 耦合强度下可分别延长激发生命期或抑制 Landau-Zener 跃迁。

item.title: 相互作用对一维Dirac半金属中手征效应的影响
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Maksim Ulybyshev, M. A. Zubkov
本文研究一维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger模型中局域Hubbard型相互作用对手征效应的影响。量子Monte Carlo模拟显示，在所研究参数范围内，即使强相互作用将体系驱动到Mott绝缘相，外电场诱导的轴向电荷密度与电导率之间的比例关系仍保持不变。结果表明局域Hubbard相互作用不会重整化该手征效应。

item.title: 富镁 Laves 相 LaMg₂ 中金属键驱动的弹性柔软性与光学响应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Farjana Mou, S. M. Nazmus Shakib Pias, M A Islam, Md Zahidur Rahaman
该研究基于密度泛函理论系统考察了立方 C15 Laves 相金属间化合物 LaMg₂ 的结构、电子、力学和光学性质。计算表明 LaMg₂ 机械稳定、具有较低弹性模量和良好延展性，主要受金属键支配。其电子结构和光学响应显示明显金属性，包括费米能级有限态密度、高反射率、低能强光电导和紫外强吸收，显示其在轻质结构和电磁屏蔽/反射部件方面具有潜力。

item.title: 超越张—赖斯范式的铜酸盐梯子中的轨道选择性氧空穴
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chengyun Hua, Tianran Chen, Isaac C. Ownby, Colin L. Sarkis, Garrett Granoth, Masaaki Matsuda, Jiaqiang Yan, Ho Nyung Lee, Jeongkeun Song, Yuya Shinohara, Masatomo Uehara, Jun Akimitsu, Oleksandr Prokhnenko, Eugen Weschke, Takeshi Egami, D. Alan Tennant
本文研究了自旋梯子铜酸盐Sr14Cu24O41的电子结构，并对张—赖斯单重态框架的普适性提出挑战。通过O K边偏振依赖共振软X射线散射与非弹性中子散射，作者发现Cu2O3梯子中的掺杂空穴主要局域在梯级氧位点的平面非键合O 2pz轨道中，而非形成常规张—赖斯单重态。该发现促使人们重新评估梯子铜酸盐中的空穴配对机制以及以铜为中心的铜酸盐超导模型是否充分。

item.title: 在手征对称性下通过哈密顿量能带拓扑控制 Liouvillian 拓扑相
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shu Long, Hong-Sen Yin, Chao Yang, Sen Mu, Jia-Wei Zhang, Linhu Li
该工作建立了二次耗散开放量子系统中哈密顿量能带拓扑与 Liouvillian 谱绕数之间的直接联系。作者证明，在特定手征耗散条件下，Liouvillian 谱绕数仅通过哈密顿量的能带绕数依赖于哈密顿量，从而可用能带拓扑调控 Liouvillian 皮肤效应。研究进一步区分了相干与非相干两类 Liouvillian 皮肤效应，为开放量子系统拓扑控制提供了统一框架。

item.title: 动态鲁棒的反绝热拓扑泵浦
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Joshua Chiel, Christopher Jarzynski, Jay Sau
该工作将反绝热驱动这一绝热捷径方法应用于 Thouless 泵浦的典型 Rice-Mele 模型。作者证明，反绝热 Rice-Mele 模型中快速跨键泵浦的电荷由陈数决定并保持鲁棒量子化。研究还构造了精确的局域最近邻反绝热哈密顿量，并显示该非绝热方案对无序和实现误差具有显著鲁棒性。

item.title: 两能带哈密顿量中的 Krylov 复杂度与保真度易感性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rishav Chaudhuri, Ayush Raj, Soham Ray, Sai Satyam Samal
该工作研究了两能带哈密顿量基态的 Krylov 扩展复杂度，其中参考态为 Bloch 球上的一般态。作者用纯几何方法从 Bloch 球数据得到扩展复杂度，并发现其导数在 SSH 模型拓扑相变处呈对数发散。研究还证明了扩展复杂度导数受保真度易感性约束，说明其对拓扑或平庸能隙闭合均敏感。

item.title: Observation of node-dependent Rydberg molecular bound states
item.description:

👤 Qing Li, Shi-Yao Shao, Jun Zhang, Han-Chao Chen, Li-Hua Zhang, Bang Liu, Guang-Can Guo, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi
arXiv:2608.09950v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultralong-range Rydberg molecules, formed by the interaction between a highly excited Rydberg atom and a ground-state atom, provide a unique platform for exploring quantum phenomena spanning nanometer-to-micrometer distances as well as exotic few-body interactions. The formation mechanisms and resultant physical properties differ markedly between s-wave and p-wave scattering channels. Here we report the experimental observation of node-dependent p-wave molecular signals in Rb(nS)-Rb(5S) Rydberg molecular spectra, where variations in the principal quantum number n directly reveal the shift of molecular binding energies induced by the moving nodal structure of the Rydberg electron wavefunction. This node-dependence is attributed to a coopera…

item.title: Symmetrized Block-Product Periodic Marginals in Infinite Translation-Invariant Quantum Chains
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xiao Zeng, Kaiyan Yang, Lingxia Zhang, Zizhu Wang
arXiv:2608.10365v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study local marginals in one-dimensional translation-invariant quantum systems that may hide finite-period structure. Given an n-site reduced density matrix, we ask whether it can be obtained by repeating a finite p-site block state along the chain and averaging over the p lattice translations. This defines a symmetrized block-product periodic marginal problem, which provides a route both to diagnosing hidden periodic order from local data and to upper bounding ground-state energy densities of infinite translation-invariant local Hamiltonians. We develop two complementary methods. The first is a semidefinite-programming relaxation based on block permutation symmetry and positive partial transpose constraints, which outer-approximates th…

item.title: 耗散强关联量子系统中的可调记忆效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Haowei Li, Yu Chen, Hui Zhai
该论文建立了一个理论框架，用于计算强关联量子多体系统中可观测量对非马尔可夫耗散的响应，并连接短时记忆效应与长时马尔可夫极限。研究预言，对于临界指数为 η 的强关联量子临界态，短时动力学普遍遵循 t²η 标度律，且与微观哈密顿量无关。作者还提出了利用超冷原子实现可调记忆时间非马尔可夫浴的方案。

item.title: Magnetic coupling between nuclear motion and nuclear spins in molecules
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Matthias Diez, Johannes K. Krondorfer, Albert Hirtenfelder, Andreas W. Hauser
arXiv:2604.19588v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among the possible types of magnetic dipole interactions in molecular systems, couplings between nuclear motion and the nuclear spin have probably received the least attention in molecular spectroscopy. Although very small in comparison to effects related to electron spin, this type of hyperfine interaction plays an important role in the NMR spectroscopy of molecular systems. While measurement and prediction of spin-rotation tensors are a common place, vibrationally induced effects still lack a comprehensive description. item.title: Spinss：通过适当的初始自旋密度加速自旋哈密顿量四态法
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该文发表于 Computer Physics Communications，主题是通过合适的初始自旋密度来加速用于自旋哈密顿量计算的四态法。输入信息仅包含出版日期、期刊卷号和作者等元数据，未提供摘要内容。根据题名可谨慎概括，该工作可能涉及计算物理中自旋哈密顿量参数求解流程的效率改进，具体算法、验证和性能结果需查阅原文。

item.title: When spin-orbit coupling meets local lattice distortions in Mott-like insulator iridates: The case of Sr₂IrO₄
item.description:
📚 Phys. Rev. Research
👤 A. Zafar, M. Jakhar, AM Milinda Abeykoon, and V. Petkov
Author(s): A. Zafar, M. Jakhar, AM Milinda Abeykoon, and V. Petkov Total x-ray scattering, structural modeling, and density functional theory calculations are used to investigate the relationship between local lattice distortions and the electronic structure of the spin-orbit-coupled Mott-like insulator Sr 2 IrO 4 . Local lattice distortions, arising from the presence of two distinct IrO 6 octahedral layers without a reduction of the average crystal symmetry, are identified, and their temperature evolution is shown to be consistent with the observed enhancement of the electronic band gap. [Phys. Rev. Research 8, L032024] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026

item.title: Magnetic ordering in VI3: a van der Waals material combining vastly different magnetic anisotropies
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 K. K. Pokhrel, S. Ray, N. Machavcova, A. Koliogiorgos, K. Carva
arXiv:2607.02759v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among magnetic van der Waals materials, the vanadium trihalide family exhibits unique features. In particular, VI3 contains V atoms of two different types, as two energetically close electronic occupations can coexist in real samples. item.title: 掺杂FeSb₂中局域磁无序与交替磁性的竞争
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Enrico Di Lucente, Michele Simoncelli
本文从第一性原理研究Co或Cr掺杂FeSb₂中的能量景观和磁态，以解释实验中由掺杂诱导的交替磁金属或磁无序状态。作者结合DFT+U与Romeo基态搜索算法，并比较虚晶近似与显式掺杂超胞方法。模拟表明Cr掺杂体系基态为局域无序自旋补偿构型，而Co掺杂体系基态为交替磁态，并提出了研究候选金属交替磁体的计算流程。

item.title: 范德华铁电体4H-SnS2中对光偏振敏感的晶体管作用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Abhishek Bajgain, Rabindra Basnet, Subhashree Chatterjee, Alexander Samokhvalov, Ramesh C. Budhani
本文确立了SnS2中的室温铁电态，并通过比较中心对称2H相与极性4H相展示其对结构多型的敏感性。研究表明，4H-SnS2三端晶体管中的内建极化可被静电栅控以及线偏振光和圆偏振光显著调制。器件表现出极化控制的电输运与光响应特征，显示其在非易失存储和光铁电功能器件中的应用潜力。

item.title: CrPS₄中的各向异性磁振子自旋输运
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Krishnaraajan Sundararajan, Muhammad Zohaib, Yulia Kreminska, Sytze H. Tirion, Bart J. van Wees
本文在单斜范德华反铁磁体CrPS₄中，通过非局域几何观测到电激发和热激发磁振子自旋输运均具有显著晶体各向异性。沿晶体b轴的磁振子自旋电导率和自旋扩散长度明显大于沿a轴的对应值，热激发信号在b轴方向也显著增强。作者同时指出，从热激发非局域二次谐波信号中可靠提取扩散长度或自旋Seebeck系数存在困难，而电激发输运更适合表征本征晶体各向异性。

item.title: 通过空间分辨REXS成像Eu(Al0.4Ga0.6)4中竞争的共线与非共线自旋织构
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fellipe B. Carneiro, Zéetény Bacsó, Kevin Allen, Aly H. Abdeldaim, Rebecca Scatena, Jaime M. Moya, Roger D. Johnson, Emilia Morosan, Alessandro Bombardi
本文利用共振弹性X射线散射研究Eu(Al₀.₄Ga₀.₆)₄零场磁自旋织构的不均匀性。空间分辨结果显示，两个磁转变来自两组近简并但不同的正交q矢量对，并对应空间分离的自旋密度波区域和螺旋区域。研究强调局域探针与整体探针得到的磁织构可能显著不同，空间分辨测量对于准确描述此类材料至关重要。

item.title: 诱导挠电应变下三维铁电极化微结构的构建与极化不变量探测
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sabarigresan Murugan, Vaishnavi S M, Ranjith Ramadurai
